work_item.title: Create Cake Recipe Documentation
work_item.intent: Write a cake recipe in markdown format inside a new 'Cake' folder within the .engineering-loop project
acceptance_criteria: Create a 'Cake' folder in the project root
Write a complete cake recipe in markdown format
Recipe should include ingredients, instructions, and basic metadata
